chunks: And everything in it that is narrated from Sama'ah ibn Mihran, I have narrated it from my father - may Allah be pleased with him - from Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from his father, from Uthman ibn Isa Al-Ghamiri, from Sama'ah ibn Mihran.

key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I narrated it, indicating the author's direct transmission.
key_terms.سَمَاعَةَ بْنِ مِهْرَانَ: Sama'ah ibn Mihran, a prominent companion of the Imams whose narrations are frequently cited.
key_terms.عَنْ أَبِي: From my father, referring to Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn Fadl al-Shaykh.
key_terms.عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عِيسَى: Uthman ibn Isa, a key narrator in the chain connecting the author's father to Sama'ah.

ai.seo_question: How did Ibn Babawayh transmit the hadiths of Sama'ah ibn Mihran in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih?
ai.summary: This introductory note clarifies the specific transmission chain (isnad) used by the author (Ibn Babawayh) for all narrations attributed to Sama'ah ibn Mihran in the book. It establishes that the author received these reports from his father, through a chain of narrators ending with Sama'ah.
